checks.claim: LUT/FF and routing are separate FPGA resource classes; architecture is series-specific.
Generic HDL recommended; RTL syntax alone does not guarantee one specific CLB resource mapping.
Incomplete combinational assignment can infer an unintended latch.
Icarus uses iverilog compilation and vvp execution for Verilog simulation.
Nonblocking assignments schedule later LHS updates after RHS evaluation; clocked coding style avoids races.
7 Series devices include wide multiplexer resources; LUT mapping depends on design and tools.
Local generated clocks need suitable routing/constraints; clock enables are preferable when staying in a single domain.
Reset startup synchronization and controlled release require design-specific care.
Functional HDL simulation and testbench use iverilog plus vvp; verification must establish actual assertions.
SPI CPOL/CPHA define idle level and leading/trailing capture edges.
NXP UM10204 Rev 7 defines START/STOP, ninth ACK, clock stretching and bus clear.
24LC256 does not ACK while internal write cycle is in progress; ACK polling determines readiness rather than assuming clock stretch.

limitations: Code simulation does not establish board-level timing.
Proposed FPGA logic and timing figures are conceptual; no hardware measurements are claimed.
No synthesis resource usage, power or Fmax benchmark is asserted.
UART, SPI and I2C examples are intentionally scoped teaching units, not production protocol IP.
